notes.title: New update is now live!
notes.content:
Hello!

We just released an update for Star Horizon that contains:
- long awaited aiming reticule (yay! \o/)
- new hangar and level select ui's in the menu
- updated shaders and textures for the mothership, asteroids and some of the ships
- some tips on the loading screens 

Have fun!

notes.title: Star Horizon - Gamepad issues fix
notes.content:
Hello!

We just released a fix that's addressing gamepad issues on Mac and Linux.

- fixed gamepad mapping for Mac and Linux
- fixed some inconsistencies when displaying icons for gamepad and keyboard/mouse controls

notes.title: Star Horizon - Official Soundtrack
notes.content:
Star Horizon Official Soundtrack is now available for download as a DLC.

Here's a list of tracks included in the package:
[list]
[*]Menu Theme
[*]Final Battle
[*]SNAFU
[*]Surpise Surprise
[*]7th Heaven
[*]Almost there
[*]Battle is over
[*]Lost in the space
[*]Doubts
[*]Space hero!
[*]Star Horizon
[/list]
